name: PopulatePasswordFieldInWindow
label: Populate Password Field in Window
description: Fills a password field in a window with a secure password value using the method you choose.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element for the password field you want to fill.

fields.name: PasswordToEnter
fields.label: Password to Enter
fields.description: The secure password value to populate the password field with.

fields.name: FillMethod
fields.label: Fill Method
fields.description: Choose how to fill the password field (Type, Paste, or Set Value).

selectOptions.label: Type
selectOptions.description: Type the password into the field.

selectOptions.label: Paste
selectOptions.description: Paste the password into the field.

selectOptions.label: Set Value
selectOptions.description: Set the password value directly (if supported).

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: IsPasswordFilled
fields.label: Is Password Filled Successfully
fields.description: Indicates whether the password was filled successfully.
